verdict.rationale: Sift's own Workflows feature is documented as a rules automation platform that makes risk-based decisions in real time during key events. Workflows tie to custom Decisions connected to backend actions, so automations run server-side without manual intervention. Evidence is thin: there are only brief tutorial and overview mentions, and the automation is event-triggered fraud decisioning rather than general background automations. Missing for 10: detailed docs on workflow configuration and autonomous action execution, recurring or scheduled background runs, broader automation beyond risk decisions, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.
Workflows enable you to make risk-based decisions in real time during key events.
Learn to set up custom Decisions, like Ban Account or Cancel Order, that are connected to real business actions in your backend.
